directions.mechanism: Investigate three verifier scheduling behaviors: group requests by verification length, shorten verification for requests whose recent drafts are repeatedly rejected, and defer verification work when a prefill step would delay decodes. Specify the observable state, decision rule, action, overhead, fallback, and strongest fixed-length comparator for each. Check whether the resolved backend supports the required per-request behavior.
directions.paper_query: speculative decoding verification scheduling under mixed prefill and decode load
directions.counterevidence_query: fixed draft length outperforms adaptive verification

directions.mechanism: Investigate three MoE dispatch changes: overlap expert dispatch with local expert work, pack small expert token groups before communication, and switch packing rules as token count changes. Identify the active MoE backend before proposing code edits; compare each change with its existing dispatch path and a fixed backend choice.
directions.paper_query: mixture of experts inference dispatch overlap small token batches

directions.mechanism: Investigate three KV admission rules: retain prefixes with high observed reuse, reserve space for expensive cold-prefill prefixes, and evict low-value entries when cache pressure rises. Specify how each rule handles hybrid or sliding-window state and how it compares with unchanged prefix caching. Treat the stated 75% cacheability target as a workload hypothesis.
directions.paper_query: cost aware KV cache admission for LLM serving

directions.mechanism: Investigate three one-node placement rules across DEP8 and two DEP4 layouts: queue-aware engine admission, prefix-residency-aware placement with a bounded queue penalty, and load-triggered placement changes. directions.paper_query: LLM serving replica routing cache locality queue delay

directions.paper_query: mixed precision mixture of experts inference quality sensitivity
